panels.scene: Sam stands alone at a kitchen counter far away, a mug beside a small green kettle, phone in hand, looking thoughtful out a window at morning light.
dialogue: I wonder if Mom had a normal morning today.

panels.scene: June, upright and busy in her sunny garden with gardening gloves and a watering can, her iPhone tucked in her cardigan pocket, tending tomato plants.
dialogue: These tomatoes need water before the sun gets high.

panels.scene: The small green stovetop kettle sits on the stove. Sam, relaxed and smiling, holds a plain phone with a blank lit screen, shoulders easing.
panels.caption: A normal morning happened.
